label: 24 Pull Requests
source: https://24pullrequests.com/projects.json (the current curated wishlist, data/24pr-raw.json), each repository then re-read via gh api repos/<owner>/<repo>
note: One row per repository the 24 Pull Requests team has listed as wanting contributions. These are WISHLIST repositories - the program does not accept or fund them, so the unit is "listed repositories" and `m` is empty because no mentor is named. 1 listed repository no longer resolves and was dropped rather than shipped as a dead link, so `projects` is the verified count. 24pullrequests.com ignores its ?year= parameter and publishes one live list, so rows carry no year: the year they were wanted is not in the API. The 10080 organizations 24 Pull Requests lists at /organisations.json are an organization rollup without project titles, kept at /data/24pr-archive.json and not merged here.
